# vastdata_de_schedule_trigger (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# Create a Data Engine schedule trigger (quartz cron).
# Runs every minute in this example: "0 * * ? * * *"

resource "vastdata_de_schedule_trigger" "hello" {
  name        = "de-test-trigger"
  tenant_name = "de-lab" # required for cluster-admin auth
  topic_name  = "engine-main"

  broker = {
    name = "de-lab-broker"
    type = "Internal"
  }

  config = {
    cron_schedule = "0 * * ? * * *"
  }
}

# ---------------------
# Complete examples
# ---------------------

resource "vastdata_de_schedule_trigger" "hourly" {
  name        = "de-sched-hourly"
  tenant_name = "de-lab"
  topic_name  = "engine-main"
  description = "Hourly schedule trigger"
  tags        = ["example", "hourly"]

  broker = {
    name                         = "de-lab-broker"
    type                         = "Internal"
    is_accessible_to_data_engine = true
  }

  config = {
    cron_schedule = "0 0 * ? * * *"
  }
}

# --------------------

resource "vastdata_de_schedule_trigger" "daily" {
  name        = "de-sched-daily"
  tenant_name = "de-lab"
  topic_name  = "engine-main"
  description = "Daily schedule trigger"
  tags        = ["example", "daily"]

  broker = {
    name                         = "de-lab-broker"
    type                         = "Internal"
    is_accessible_to_data_engine = false
  }

  config = {
    cron_schedule = "0 0 0 ? * * *"
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `config` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config))
- `name` (String) A name for the trigger. Must contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

### Optional

- `broker` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--broker))
- `description` (String) A description of the resource.
- `tags` (Set of String) Custom tags for organizing and categorizing resources in the GUI.
- `tenant_name` (String) Tenant name for Data Engine API queries. Required for cluster-admin auth; optional when the provider already authenticates as that tenant.
- `topic_name` (String) The name of the topic in the broker. Used with broker field for automatic topic creation.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was created.
- `guid` (String) A globally unique identifier (GUID) for the resource.
- `id` (Number) A globally unique identifier (ID) for the resource.
- `owner` (Attributes) Represents the owner of the resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owner))
- `status` (String) Operational status of the object.
- `tenant_guid` (String) A globally unique identifier (GUID) for the resource.
- `topic` (String) A logical path for resource grouping and policy assignment. The structure of the logical path is: vast:dataengine:<resource type>:<custom structure per type>
where resource type is one of: triggers / functions / pipelines / topics / kubernetes-clusters / container-registries / mtls-authentication-credentials.
- `type` (String)
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was last updated.
- `vrn` (String) A logical path for resource grouping and policy assignment. The structure of the logical path is: vast:dataengine:<resource type>:<custom structure per type>
where resource type is one of: triggers / functions / pipelines / topics / kubernetes-clusters / container-registries / mtls-authentication-credentials.

### Nested Schema for `broker`

Required:

- `name` (String) Broker name for external or Bucket (View) name for internal.
- `type` (String)

Optional:

- `is_accessible_to_data_engine` (Boolean) When true (default), the Data Engine will periodically validate that the broker is accessible. Set to false if the broker is not reachable from the Data Engine (e.g., external brokers behind firewalls).
- `url` (String) Deprecated. The broker URL is now resolved from VMS by broker name. This field is ignored for VMS-registered brokers and only used as a legacy fallback for brokers not yet registered in VMS. It will be removed in a future release.
